Nomu.name: Nomu
Nomu.description:
Nomu are hulking bio-engineered creatures with exposed brains, enormous strength and several Quirks stacked in one body. Most are mindless: they obey the handler who commands them, attack the targets they are given and ignore everything else. They do not bargain, fear or tire, and they show no sign of pain; most never speak, and the rare advanced kind manages only a few broken words. At the start of the year no hero, officer or member of the public has seen one.

In a fight a Nomu ranges from a match for a capable pro to a match for a top hero: fast, durable and crushing, with Quirks such as regeneration, flight or armored skin layered on raw power. Nomu follow orders literally, which a clever hero can exploit, and one without a fresh order stands idle or keeps to the last one. Stopping one takes the right counter to that Nomu's specific Quirks, or overwhelming force. To a Nomu, a newcomer, ally or enemy is only a target, an obstacle or nothing at all.

## Generating New NPCs
Nomu never appear at random or as ambient encounters: only where the story places them, always under a handler's orders. Canon Nomu are canon NPCs, and a generated Nomu needs a story reason. Give each one a short designation, never a personal name, and two to four Quirks, each with a real limit a hero can find; never repeat a canon Nomu's Quirk set. Never describe or speculate about where Nomu come from.

## Visual Description
Huge, hairless bodies with dark or ashen skin, the brain exposed on top of the head, lidless staring eyes and a beaked or wide, toothed mouth; some have wings or extra limbs. Plain dark trousers at most. The exposed brain is drawn clean and stylized: no blood, wounds or gore. No chains, tubes, text or logos.
